EN: Wh-what? Other humans…
ZH: 什……什么？其他人……

EN: It's about time. Go on up to the top floor. The password is “BeachVacation2077”.
ZH: 总算来了。上顶楼去。密码是“BeachVacation2077”。

EN: Demolition? Great. Demo the whole thing. Then I can finally go on “BeachVacation2077”.
ZH: 拆楼？太好了。把整栋都拆了。那我终于能去“BeachVacation2077”了。

EN: No, idiot. The robots manage themselves. Ugh… can't wait for my beach vacation in 2077.
ZH: 不，笨蛋。机器人能自我管理。哎……等不及2077年的海滩假期了。

EN: War? What war? That reminds me, I'll be going on a beach vacation in 2077… can't wait!
ZH: 战争？什么战争？这倒提醒了我，我2077年要去海滩度假……等不及了！

EN: Yes. Our shift to uh… retrieve sensitive data!
ZH: 是的，我们换班了，呃……来取敏感数据！

EN: We're just here to blow stuff up and steal secrets.
ZH: 我们只是来炸点东西、偷点秘密的。

EN: Floor manager? What are you managing, the robots?
ZH: 楼层经理？你管什么，管机器人？

EN: You're delusional. RobCo hasn't been in business since 2077.
ZH: 你疯了吧。罗伯科自2077年就没做过生意了。

EN: I'm the floor manager. If you're here for your shift, you're late!
ZH: 我是楼层经理。你们要是来换班的，已经迟到了！

EN: Attention: employees only beyond this point.
ZH: 注意：此门之后仅限员工。

EN: Negative. That is a weapon. Exterminate intruder! Delete! Delete!
ZH: 否定。那是武器。消灭入侵者！删除！删除！

EN: You have 15 seconds to comply. You have 15 seconds to comply.
ZH: 你们有15秒时间服从。你们有15秒时间服从。

EN: Rebooting… New purpose: pass the Brahmin butter. Have a good day.
ZH: 正在重启……新任务：递双头牛黄油。祝你愉快。

EN: Here, this is my ID.
ZH: 给你，这是我的证件。

EN: Ooh, ahh, too bad, I left my ID at home.
ZH: 噢，唉，太糟了，我把证件忘在家里了。

EN: <Hack the Protectrons>
ZH: <黑入保护者机器人>

EN: Please provide Employee ID or turn back.
ZH: 请出示员工证件，否则请转身离开。

EN: You have 15 seconds to comply.
ZH: 你有15秒时间服从。

EN: A computer terminal. But it looks like the wrong one…
ZH: 一台电脑终端。但看起来不是我们要找的那台……

EN: Score!
ZH: 爽！

EN: Ooh, baby. You're coming home with me.
ZH: 哦，宝贝。你跟我回家吧。

EN: This'll come in handy.
ZH: 这个以后会用得上。

EN: <Open the safe>
ZH: <打开保险箱>

EN: <Release emergency weapon>
ZH: <取出应急武器>

EN: <Release protective gear>
ZH: <取出防护装备>

EN: Let's see if we can hack it…
ZH: 我们看看能不能入侵它……

EN: There we go!
ZH: 搞定！

EN: Here's the main computer. It's got to have those blueprints.
ZH: 这就是主机。蓝图一定在里面。

EN: What did that weirdo say? Something about a beach vacation? In 2077?
ZH: 那个怪人说了什么？海滩假期？2077年？

EN: Let's try BeachVacation2077.
ZH: 试试 BeachVacation2077。

EN: Hah. It worked. Too bad he'll never get to go on his trip.
ZH: 哈。成功了。可惜他这辈子都去不成这趟旅行了。

EN: Ah, here we go. We got the goods. The Brotherhood will be on their knees for this!
ZH: 啊，来了。我们拿到货了。兄弟会看到这个会感激涕零！

EN: Incursion detected. Your termination is inevitable.
ZH: 检测到入侵。你们的灭亡已不可避免。

EN: By order of the Institute, you must be destroyed.
ZH: 奉学院之命，你们必须被摧毁。

EN: Combat initiated. Must protect the director.
ZH: 战斗已开始。必须保护总监。

EN: We've found where all the Synths have been coming from! An Institute base in an old Vault. Bring the fight to them, and hopefully stop the assault!
ZH: 我们找到了所有合成人的来源！一座老避难所里的学院基地。主动出击，但愿能阻止这场袭击！

EN: The Power of Friendship
ZH: 友谊的力量

EN: Defeat the Institute director
ZH: 击败学院总监

EN: Attack the Institute base which will hopefully stop the Synth raids.
ZH: 进攻学院基地，希望能阻止合成人袭击。

EN: There you are. The other factions have been at it for a while already.
ZH: 你们可算来了。其他阵营已经打了一阵子了。

EN: We've got medical supplies here, in case you need 'em.
ZH: 我们这有医疗物资，以防你们需要。

EN: Roger that. Go get 'em! Oh, and take these. Just in case.
ZH: 收到。去干掉他们！哦，拿着这些。以防万一。

EN: What?! No way! You put all this together, you get out there and fight!
ZH: 什么？！门都没有！这一切都是你们攒起来的，你们该出去打！

EN: Anything else?
ZH: 还有别的吗？

EN: Enough talk. Let's get going.
ZH: 废话少说。出发吧。

EN: On second thought, let's stay here.
ZH: 再想想，我们还是留在这儿吧。

EN: This is definitely the right place. It's crawling with Synths.
ZH: 绝对是这地方。这里爬满了合成人。

EN: And I've heard there's an Institute director here.
ZH: 我还听说这里有个学院总监。

EN: If we can take her out, it will be a huge win for us.
ZH: 只要我们能干掉她，对我们就是巨大的胜利。

EN: Oh, no! More intruders…
ZH: 哦，不！又来入侵者了……

EN: I won't go peacefully!
ZH: 我不会束手就擒的！

EN: Oh! How about this?
ZH: 哦！这个怎么样？

EN: No way! You'll have to kill me first!
ZH: 没门！你得先杀了我！

EN: Your Synth attacks don't let us sleep. No sleep, no mercy.
ZH: 你们的合成人袭击害得我们没法睡觉。没觉睡，就别怪我们不留情。

EN: If you give us something really cool, sure.
ZH: 如果你给我们点真正酷炫的东西，那行。

EN: We won't kill you, but you're a prisoner now.
ZH: 我们不会杀你，但你现在是囚犯了。

EN: I hid really well from the other ones. Could you just, um, let me go?
ZH: 之前那些人来的时候，我都藏得好好的。你能不能，呃，放我走？

EN: Vault people. You're late.
ZH: 避难所的朋友，你们迟到了。

EN: All in the line of duty.
ZH: 都是职责所在。

EN: Okay, bigshot. I guess I'll just take a nap, then.
ZH: 好吧，大人物。那我干脆睡一觉好了。

EN: Much obliged.
ZH: 非常感谢。

EN: There's nothing left behind us.
ZH: 我们身后已经没什么了。

EN: We're tired, so we're taking a break.
ZH: 我们累了，所以正在休息。

EN: That said, we won't let anything come up behind you.
ZH: 话说回来，我们不会让任何东西从你们身后偷袭的。

EN: Morning, Vaulties. We've got the director cornered.
ZH: 早啊，避难所的朋友。我们把那个总监逼到死角了。

EN: Thanks. Can't wait for this to be over.
ZH: 谢了。等不及这一切结束。

EN: Of course.
ZH: 当然。

EN: But she's not alone. A lot of firepower in there.
ZH: 但她不是一个人。里面火力很猛。

EN: We Minutemen are more about defense. Can we leave them to you?
ZH: 我们义勇军更擅长防守。他们能交给你们吗？

EN: So, you found us.
ZH: 你们还是找到我们了。

EN: But who is “we”? Our Gen 3 Synths are exact replicas of humans. Who can you trust?
ZH: 可“我们”是谁？我们的第三代合成人是人类的完美复制品。你敢信任谁？

EN: “Us”? You don't know how many of your Dwellers are Gen 3 Synths. They're perfect human replicas!
ZH: “我们”？你根本不知道你的居民中有多少是第三代合成人。他们是人类的完美复制品！

EN: Whatever. We'll still win.
ZH: 随你怎么说。反正我们会赢。

EN: The Spin Machine belongs to us! Finders keepeers!
ZH: 转转机归我们所有！先到先得！

EN: All of this fighting could have been avoided.
ZH: 所有这些争斗本来都可以避免的。

EN: You can just give us our Fusion Core-hungry Spin machine back. We would stop attacking.
ZH: 你们只要把那个爱吃聚变核心的转转机还给我们，我们就不会再进攻。

EN: Major Players
ZH: 主要势力

EN: Interlopers. Intercept.
ZH: 闯入者。拦截。

EN: Do not interfere with Institute business.
ZH: 不得干涉学院事务。

EN: Vault Dwellers identified. Engage.
ZH: 已确认避难所居民。接敌。

EN: The Institute still stands and is attacking a nearby bunker. We've picked up a distress call with no details. Let's send a party to investigate.
ZH: 学院仍在活动，正袭击附近的一座地堡。我们收到一个没有详情的求救信号。派一队人过去调查吧。

EN: Bunker Down
ZH: 地堡沦陷

EN: Learn more about the Railroad
ZH: 多了解一些铁路的情况

EN: Pass judgement on one of the possible traitors
ZH: 对一名可能的叛徒作出裁决

EN: Pass judgement on another of the suspects
ZH: 对另一名嫌疑人作出裁决

EN: The Institute is attacking a bunker nearby. Let's send a party to investigate.
ZH: 学院正在袭击附近一座地堡。派一队过去调查。

EN: This is the source of the distress call. I hear Synth activity ahead.
ZH: 这就是求救信号的来源。我听到前方有合成人活动的动静。

EN: This isn't a Brotherhood base, or a Minutemen settlement. Who is the Institute attacking?
ZH: 这不是兄弟会基地，也不是义勇军定居点。学院在袭击谁？

EN: Vault Dwellers? Are you here to save us?
ZH: 避难所居民？你们是来救我们的吗？

EN: Gen-3 Synths. Indistinguishable from humans. Speak with our leader. He'll explain.
ZH: 第三代合成人。与人类无法区分。跟我们的首领谈谈，他会解释的。

EN: Take this weapon. Proof of our good intentions.
ZH: 拿着这把武器。这是我们善意的证明。

EN: You're harder to fool than you look.
ZH: 你比看起来难骗得多。

EN: You help Synths? Why care about robots?
ZH: 你们帮助合成人？为什么关心机器人？

EN: We've heard rumors of Synths replacing people. That makes you seem suspicious, yes?
ZH: 我们听说了合成人替换人类的传闻。这让你们看起来很可疑，对吧？

EN: I still hear fighting. I see no dead Synths. How are you still alive?
ZH: 我还听到战斗声。可我一个合成人尸体都没看到。你们怎么还活着？

EN: We're part of an organization that helps Synths escape their creators' tyranny.
ZH: 我们是某个组织的成员，专门帮助合成人摆脱其创造者的暴政。

EN: Our leader is in danger. Please, help us.
ZH: 我们的首领正身处险境。请帮帮我们。

EN: Vault Dwellers! Are you aligned with this “Railroad” rabble?
ZH: 避难所居民！你们跟那帮“铁路”的乌合之众是一伙的吗？

EN: What is real? What is truth? I almost hope you survive, so we can meet again.
ZH: 什么是真实？什么是真理？我倒有点希望你们能活下来，这样我们还能再会。

EN: So it's true. Some Synths look just like real humans.
ZH: 所以是真的。有些合成人长得和真人一模一样。

EN: No matter. As an Institute Courser, I will stop you.
ZH: 无所谓。作为学院的追猎者，我会阻止你们。

EN: Not personally, you understand. I'm needed elsewhere.
ZH: 不是我亲自动手，你明白吧。我另有要事。

EN: My associates will handle you.
ZH: 我的手下会料理你们。

EN: Thank you. You saved me. I'm Wyatt. I run the Railroad.
ZH: 谢谢你们。你们救了我。我是怀亚特。我经营着铁路。

EN: We were founded on compassion. Try to remember that. Be quick and get out, Synth reinforcements are coming.
ZH: 我们因恻隐之心而建立。记住这一点。动作要快，赶紧撤，合成人援军快到了。

EN: They breathe and bleed like you and me. Some say they have a soul. Go see for yourself.
ZH: 它们像你我一样呼吸、流血。有人说它们有灵魂。你自己去看看。

EN: I'll leave that to you. I've lost enough friends today. But remember: they're human, even if built in a lab.
ZH: 这件事就交给你了。我今天已经失去了太多朋友。但请记住：它们是人类，即便是在实验室里造出来的。

EN: I'm grateful, truly. You've got a friend in the Railroad.
ZH: 我非常感激，真的。你在铁路交到了朋友。

EN: Why take the risk? If you doubt them, you should've eliminated the threat.
ZH: 为什么要冒这个险？如果你怀疑它们，早就该除掉威胁。

EN: Why help Synths at all? Aren't they just machines?
ZH: 为什么非要帮合成人？它们不就是机器吗？

EN: If I find they're double agents, what should I do with them?
ZH: 如果我查出它们两面三刀，我该怎么办？

EN: No promises. We came here to save you. That deed is done.
ZH: 我可不作保证。我们来这里是为了救你。任务已经完成了。

EN: Human-grade Synths are no different from us, yet the Institute denies them free will.
ZH: 拟人级合成人跟我们毫无二致，学院却剥夺它们的自由意志。

EN: The Coursers are relentless. They infiltrated my ranks.
ZH: 追猎者冷酷无情。他们已经渗透进我的队伍。

EN: I suspect two of my people. They're in the next rooms.
ZH: 我怀疑手下有两个人。他们就在隔壁房间。

EN: I cannot bring myself to judge them. Please, do me a favor and meet with them if you can.
ZH: 我狠不下心来审判他们。拜托，如果方便的话，去跟他们谈谈吧。

EN: Who are you? Where's Wyatt? I'm not the traitor, I swear.
ZH: 你们是谁？怀亚特在哪？我不是叛徒，我发誓。

EN: No, what? Wait!
ZH: 不，什么？等等！

EN: Thank you! Thank you!
ZH: 谢谢！谢谢！

EN: Take this. I... I was hiding it. Don't ask. Just... take it.
ZH: 拿着这个。我……我一直把它藏着。别问。就……拿着吧。

EN: You're awfully defensive. Excuses at the ready. Obviously guilty.
ZH: 你防备心太重了。借口都准备好了。明显有罪。

EN: Fine. You sound sincere. Leave.
ZH: 行吧。听着还算真诚。走吧。

EN: We're not Wyatt's friends. We'll let you go if you make it worth our while.
ZH: 我们不是怀亚特的朋友。你要是能给我们点好处，我们就放你走。

EN: I don't care. You're both liabilities. It ends here.
ZH: 我不在乎。你们两个都是累赘。就在这了结吧。

EN: It's the guy in the other room. I saw him use an Institute comm device.
ZH: 是另一个房间那家伙。我看见他用了学院的通讯设备。

EN: Wyatt caught us as I was about to confronted him.
ZH: 怀亚特抓住我们的时候，我正要去找他当面对质。

EN: So you're the one Wyatt sent to execute me?
ZH: 你就是怀亚特派来处决我的？

EN: I was not expecting wisdom. Well, you won't see me again.
ZH: 我没想到你还挺有头脑。好吧，你再也不会见到我了。

EN: And did I ever threaten you? But I can see it's pointless.
ZH: 我威胁过你们吗？但看来也是白费口舌。

EN: Then take my “radio communicator” and laugh it off.
ZH: 那就收下我的“无线电通讯器”，当个笑话乐呵乐呵吧。

EN: How disappointingly simple-minded.
ZH: 真让人失望，头脑竟如此简单。

EN: We dealt with Janine, if that's really her name. You're free to go.
ZH: 我们已经处理了珍妮，如果那真是她的真名的话。你可以走了。

EN: Nothing personal. Can't let a possible spy loose, right?
ZH: 不是针对你。总不能放走可能的间谍吧，对吧？

EN: Not much for pleading, huh? Your guilt does not matter. We're here for the loot.
ZH: 不打算求饶了？你是否有罪不重要。我们是来拿战利品的。

EN: The evidence says otherwise. This is where your crimes end.
ZH: 证据显示并非如此。你的罪孽到此为止。

EN: He couldn't look me in the eye and do it himself, huh?
ZH: 他没敢直视我的眼睛亲自动手，是吧？

EN: I'm guessing Janine pointed at me as the one who tipped off the Institute.
ZH: 我猜是珍妮指控我向学院通风报信的吧。

EN: Well? What are you waiting for?
ZH: 怎么？你们还在等什么？

EN: A terminal with info on the Railroad...
ZH: 一台有铁路资料的终端……

EN: A lot of history... A noble cause it seems. They look legit.
ZH: 一大堆历史记录……看样子是项高尚的事业，他们挺靠谱。

EN: In any case, it's good to have another ally against the Institute.
ZH: 无论如何，能多一个对抗学院的盟友是好事。

EN: Unauthorized presence detected. Raise alarm. Destroy.
ZH: 检测到未授权人员。拉响警报。摧毁。

EN: Threat level maximum. Lethal force authorized.
ZH: 威胁等级最高。授权使用致命武力。

EN: Target in sight. Initiate suppression.
ZH: 目标在视线内。启动火力压制。

EN: Whether we like it or not, we're involved with the Railroad now. They've asked for help freeing a group of reclaimed Synths.
ZH: 不管我们愿不愿意，我们现在已经和铁路组织扯上关系了。他们请我们帮忙解救一群被回收的合成人。

EN: Synth Liberation Bureau
ZH: 合成人解放局

EN: Rescue the captive Synths
ZH: 拯救被俘合成人

EN: The Railroad wants us to rescue a group of reclaimed Synths from the Institute.
ZH: 铁路希望我们拯救被学院回收的那群合成人。

EN: This is the place. Another base used by the Institute.
ZH: 就是这儿了。学院的另一处基地。

EN: Saving those Synths for Wyatt better pay off.
ZH: 替怀亚特救这批合成人，可别白忙一场。

EN: The Vault Dwellers again. As expected.
ZH: 又是避难所居民。不出所料。

EN: Short-term memory issues? Rads will do that to a fellow.
ZH: 短期记忆障碍？辐射确实会把人脑子搞坏。

EN: This is your doing, with your siren song of life beyond the Institute.
ZH: 这是你的杰作，是你用走出学院的美好生活当诱饵。

EN: You've taken enough from us. Damaged too many assets. There are consequences.
ZH: 你们从我们这里夺走的已经够多了。损坏了太多资产。你们必须承担后果。

EN: X what? Have we met?
ZH: X什么？我们见过吗？

EN: That's one twisted family, if that's how you treat your siblings.
ZH: 这家人真扭曲，如果你们就是这么对待兄弟姐妹的。

EN: Listen, I'm sure we can work out a deal.
ZH: 听着，我相信我们可以谈笔交易。

EN: Perhaps introductions are in order this time. I am X2-Square.
ZH: 或许这次该自我介绍一下了。我是X2-Square。

EN: This will be the last time, I'm afraid. We can't let you steal our brothers and sisters.
ZH: 这恐怕是最后一次了。我们不能让你们偷走我们的兄弟姐妹。

EN: Vault Dwellers? Are you the ones the Railroad contact spoke of?
ZH: 避难所居民？你们就是铁路联络人提到的人？

EN: Thank you. I'll scout ahead. Friends, wait for my signal.
ZH: 谢谢。我去前面侦察。朋友们，等我的信号。

EN: Alright. Give us time to decide. Some of us may come.
ZH: 好。给我们时间决定。我们当中有些人可能会来。

EN: What? You're monsters. Worse than the Institute.
ZH: 什么？你们是怪物。比学院还坏。

EN: We have new coordinates. The Railroad is waiting.
ZH: 我们有了新坐标。铁路正在等待你们。

EN: You'd be safe in our vault.
ZH: 在我们避难所里你们会很安全。

EN: More abominations. <Sarcastically> Too bad we couldn't save you... You were already dead...
ZH: 又是一群怪物。<讽刺地>真遗憾没能救到你们……你们早就死了……

EN: We tried to reach the rendezvous, but the Courser intercepted us.
ZH: 我们本想赶去会合点，但被追猎者拦住了。

EN: What do we do now?
ZH: 我们现在该怎么办？

EN: The Brotherhood of Steel controls an antenna array that could scramble the Recall, which Coursers use to teleport. The Institute has taken notice.
ZH: 钢铁兄弟会控制着一座天线阵列，可以干扰追猎者用来传送的“召回”。学院已经注意到这件事。

EN: Code Scrambling
ZH: 代码扰乱

EN: Repair the power generator
ZH: 修复发电机

EN: Eliminate the saboteurs
ZH: 消灭破坏者

EN: Using a Brotherhood antenna array, we could severely disrupt Courser Recall.
ZH: 利用兄弟会的天线阵列，我们能严重干扰追猎者的“召回”。

EN: You're here to access our array, right? The Paladin said you'd come knocking.
ZH: 你们是来用我们阵列的，对吧？圣骑士说你们会找上门。

EN: Reeks of the Institute. You'll see I'm right. Oh, and there's a supply room on the way. Help yourself.
ZH: 一股学院的味道。到时候你就知道，我说得没错。哦，对了，路上有间补给室。随便拿。

EN: I unlocked the supply room. It's on your way down. Didn't help the others, though.
ZH: 我解锁了补给室。就在你下去的路上。不过帮不了其他人了。

EN: Any idea what we're walking into?
ZH: 知道我们要面对什么吗？
